# Comments and code

Visible text stays.
The quarter went well.

Text before text after.

Start of line
and the rest of the line stays.

```js
// %% this is code, not a comment %%
const tag = "#not-a-tag";
```

Inline code `%%kept%%` and `#kept` stays as written.

This note is called and has pages.

> **Inside a callout**
> A line in the callout.
>
> The callout goes on.

~~~
A tilde fence with ``` inside
~~~

The end.
